interface.longDescription: A lightweight source-first PowerPoint/PPTX workflow for coding agents. One capable model chooses content-led composition, with optional questions and style previews. Native methods, charts and tables remain editable; scientific figures reserve readable captions and interpretation. Deterministic checks preserve source content and expose focused repairs. Verified render reuse speeds unchanged rebuilds without reusing visual approval.
